stops.name: Stórhöfði
stops.detail: About 4,600 years ago, the ash crater Stórhöfði was formed on Heimaey.

stops.name: Sæfell
stops.detail: The ash cone of Sæfell on Heimaey, on the other hand, formed in a very explosive eruption about 4,300 years ago, which in turn also generated pyroclastic flows.

stops.name: Norðurklettar
stops.detail: About 7,500 years ago, the Norðurklettar cliffs were then formed, also in the northwest of Heimaey.

stops.name: Háin
stops.detail: The tuff cone Háin owes its creation to explosive eruptions with pyroclastic flows in the northwest of Heimaey about 8,000 years ago.
